headers.//: MUST be `**`, not `/index.html`. Hosting matches header rules against the REQUESTED path, not the rewrite destination, and nobody requests /index.html - the site is loaded at `/`, `/store`, `/summit/2026` and so on. Without this every route fell through to Hosting default max-age=3600, so a visitor kept the PREVIOUS index.html for up to an hour after a deploy, and that HTML names the old hashed bundles - which really are immutable - pinning the whole stale site. Diagnosed on the admin app 2026-08-27 and fixed here at the same time.
AFTER the catch-all deliberately: where two rules match, the LAST wins, so hash-named assets keep their long cache. Verified against a live site before shipping - do not reorder.
